detail: Full summary: DROP from the structural plan — refuted by field data: the capture-model redesign (H1), Gate 1 enforcement hardening (H7 shows 90.7% voluntary compliance), the warning-drain/ratchet fix (H3b: zero of 31 warnings older than 30 days), scope-degradation handling (H4 3.7%), and the catastrophic framing of archiving (H2d: 209 findings and 31 warnings still live).
